chunks: And by this chain, from Abī Saʿīd, raising it, from Abī Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:

Rasūl Allāh (صلى الله عليه وآله) said: From my offspring are twelve naqībs, noble ones, muhaddathūn, ones granted understanding. The last of them is al-Qāʾim bi-al-Ḥaqq, who will fill it with justice just as it had been filled with tyranny.

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ بِالْحَقِّ: the one who rises with the truth
key_terms.مُحَدَّثُونَ: those addressed or spoken to, traditionally understood as recipients of divine inspiration without prophethood

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of the twelve from the offspring of Rasūl Allāh (صلى الله عليه وآله) say about al-Qāʾim bi-al-Ḥaqq?
ai.summary: This hadith states that from the offspring of Rasūl Allāh (صلى الله عليه وآله) there will be twelve chosen leaders distinguished by nobility, divine communication, and deep understanding. It concludes with the final one, al-Qāʾim bi-al-Ḥaqq, who will establish justice throughout the earth after it had been overwhelmed by oppression.
